selection: All symbols of the uniquely matched HDLC-stuffed AX.25 frame plus FCS; flags, preamble and silence excluded.
normalization: Both traces divided by the same post-Costas frame RMS magnitude; no extra phase rotation or point removal.
before_trace: Matched-filter/timing/FLL output before Costas phase recovery
after_trace: Same symbols after order-2 Costas phase recovery
limitations: Selected successfully decoded frame; not BER, packet reception rate, calibrated EVM or receiver sensitivity. Raw BPSK symbol polarities are not AX.25 bits before NRZI/G3RUH decoding.
